summary: This directory defines the structural schemas for analyzing TypeScript class and interface members. It provides a standardized framework for categorizing members as either properties or methods, and distinguishes them by their capability to support JSDoc documentation.
responsibilities: Define runtime schemas for validating member analysis objects
Categorize class and interface members by kind and documentability
Specify metadata requirements for properties and methods
Provide unified type representations for all member analysis variants
relationships: Member analysis is categorized into either property or method types.
Each member type is further classified as documentable or non-documentable.
Base member schemas provide the structural foundation for both property and method analysis.
The union of specific property and method analysis schemas forms the comprehensive member analysis set.
designDecisions: Use of Effect schemas for runtime validation and type inference
Strict categorization via literal types for member kinds
Separation of concerns between documentable and non-documentable analysis structures
